entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: I-I'm sorry... Please forgive me...

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: I-I couldn't stop obsessing... N-Not after this[n]person I trusted used me and then disposed[n]of me.
Which person?
Still blaming others?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hold on, are you talkin' about that guy[n]you mentioned earlier... Madarame?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You don't have to be so hard on[n]him anymore. He seems like he's[n]sorry.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So this person you trusted... Is this the[n]Madarame that you were talking about[n]before?

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: I... was afraid of being thrown away[n]again like some worthless thing.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So some selfish bastard was making you[n]suffer too...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Still, you shouldn't have dragged an[n]unrelated woman into your mess.

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: Yes, I know that now. I'll put an end to[n]my love for her...

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: ...Hey, you can change people's hearts,[n]right?

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: In that case...

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: Won't you change Madarame's heart!?[n]Before more people fall victim to him...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Change... Madarame's heart?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hm? What's that shinin' thing?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's the bud of a Treasure.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Had we left it be, it very well may have[n]blossomed into a Palace.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Joker, this will make a perfect reward!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So Nakanohara had a change of heart,[n]right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Most likely.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But how are we supposed to know if we[n]succeeded?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The lady posted the dude's name online.[n]If he really does change, she'll prolly[n]comment again.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm, you do have a point.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Either way, trainin' against Shadows[n]down here's the best! It's great prep for[n]our next target!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's also nice to be able to give courage[n]to the people who post their problems[n]online.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: On top of that, we can sell whatever[n]treasure we get for some cold, hard cash!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sounds like things are goin' pretty great[n]for us!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...All right, we did it!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hold on. There's somewhere I want[n]to show you guys before we leave.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What, there's more?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't worry, it won't take long.
